proof_scope: The claim-bind gate is fail-closed: it PASSES a draft whose numeric facts are all present in the approved claim ledger, and REJECTS (non-zero, with an ops_recruiter_claim_unbacked triage-shaped failure) a draft asserting a numeric metric absent from the ledger. The status contract exposes email_send and linkedin_automation as PERMANENTLY_FORBIDDEN and routes drafting/humanizing through $ask (COMPOSED_VIA_ASK), not a coding agent. Run via the real skill entrypoint.

claims.proves: ops-recruiter gate rejects an unbacked fabricated metric and accepts a ledger-backed draft; status declares no-send and web*-composed writing boundaries
claims.does_not_prove: live webgpt/webkimi draft quality, live /gmail or ops-linkedin ingestion, or Memory /store against a running daemon

capability_claims.description: Fail-closed claim-bind check refuses draft facts absent from the approved ledger.
Never sends; drafting is composed via $ask web* models, not a coding agent.
Stored recruiter correspondence is recalled so build marks an existing relationship and never writes first-contact for a known thread.
The John reply is actually produced through the live webgpt->webkimi chain and the produced draft passes the claim-bind gate (capability, not wiring).

cases.name: gate-rejects-unbacked-and-status-boundaries
command: cd .. && ./run.sh status --json | grep -q '"email_send": "PERMANENTLY_FORBIDDEN"' && ./run.sh status --json | grep -q COMPOSED_VIA_ASK && ./sanity.sh

stdout_contains: E2E PASS: produced John reply via webgpt->webkimi and gate PASSED
